pages.text: $(bold)The End portal needs sixteen $(thing)different$(n) eyes. None can be crafted, mined or found.$(br2)Each is a node on the last ring, behind the final seal. Unlocking one gives you its eye.
pages.title: IV. The Sixteen Eyes
Where They Come From
pages.text: $(bold)$(li)Each eye's task is a boss kill: the six bosses of Bosses' Rise, the eight of Cataclysm, Azazel and the Wither.$(br)$(li)Without a boss's mod, its node asks for other work.$(br2)Every eye and its boss is listed under $(l:eyes/about)The Sixteen Eyes$(n).

pages.title: You Cannot Waste a Boss
pages.text: $(bold)A boss takes no damage from you until a node that asks for it is reachable.$(br2)Kill it again after unlocking its eye node, carrying none of that eye, and you get another.
